40023121.author: पदार्थः
40023121.content: तथा thus, तयोः of those two, संवदतोः while conversing, दुर्वासा Durvasa, भगवान् revered, ऋषिः sage, रामस्य of Rama, दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी desiring the sight, राजद्वारम् royal gate, उपागमत् approached.

40023121.author: Translation
40023121.content: While those two were thus conversing, the revered sage Durvasa, desiring an audience with Rama, approached the royal gate.

40023122.author: पदार्थः
40023122.content: सः he, अभिगम्य having approached, तु indeed, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, उवाच said, ऋषिसत्तमः the best of sages, रामम् Rama, दर्शय show, मे to me, शीघ्रम् quickly, पुरा before, मे my, अर्थः purpose, अतिवर्तते passes away.

40023122.author: Translation
40023122.content: Having approached Saumitri, the best of sages indeed said, "Show Rama to me quickly, before my purpose passes away."

40023123.author: पदार्थः
40023123.content: मुनेः of the sage, तु indeed, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed,

40023123.author: Translation
40023123.content: Having heard the words of the sage, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, saluted the great-souled one and then spoke these words.

40023124.author: पदार्थः
40023124.content: किम् what, कार्यम् task, ब्रूहि tell, भगवन् O revered one, कः what, वा or, अर्थः purpose, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, अहम् I, व्यग्रः busy, हि indeed, राघवः Rama, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, प्रतिपाल्यताम् let him be waited for,

40023124.author: Translation
40023124.content: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."

40023125.author: पदार्थः
40023125.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषिशार्दूलः the tiger among sages, क्रोधेन by anger, कलुषीकृतः agitated, उवाच said, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, निर्दहन् burning, इव as if, चक्षुषा with his eyes,

40023125.author: Translation
40023125.content: Having heard that, the tiger among sages, agitated by anger, spoke words to Lakshmana as if burning him with his eyes.

40023126.author: पदार्थः
40023126.content: अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, रामाय to Rama, प्रतिवेदय announce, अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, न not, निवेदयसे you announce, यदि if,

40023126.author: Translation
40023126.content: The sage commanded, "O son of Sumitra, announce me to Rama this very moment; if you do not announce me to Rama this very moment, O son of Sumitra..."

40023127.author: पदार्थः
40023127.content: विषयम् the kingdom, त्वाम् you, पुरम् the city, च and, एव indeed, शपिष्ये I shall curse, राघवम् Rama, तथा and, भरतम् Bharata, च and, एव indeed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, युष्माकम् your, या which, च and, सन्ततिः progeny,

40023127.author: Translation
40023127.content: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.

40023128.author: पदार्थः
40023128.content: न not, हि indeed, शक्ष्यामि I shall be able, अहं I, भूयो again, मन्युं anger, धारयितुं to hold, हृदि in the heart, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरसङ्काशं terrible-looking, वाक्यं word, तस्य of him, महात्मनः of the great soul, चिन्तयामास he thought, मनसा with the mind, तस्य of that, वाक्यस्य of the speech, निश्चयम् the certainty.

40023128.author: Translation
40023128.content: Having heard the terrible words of that great soul, he pondered in his mind the definite meaning of that statement, realizing he could no longer contain his anger.

40023129.author: पदार्थः
40023129.content: एकस्य of one, मरणं death, मे for me, अस्तु let it be, मा not, भूत् let it be, सर्वविनाशनम् destruction of all, इति thus, बुद्ध्या with intellect, विनिश्चित्य having decided, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् he reported.

40023129.author: Translation
40023129.content: Deciding with his intellect that it was better for one person to die than for everyone to be destroyed, he reported this to Rama.

40023130.author: पदार्थः
40023130.content: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, कालं Kala, विसृज्य having dismissed, च and, निस्सृत्य having come out, त्वरितं quickly, राजा the king, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रं the son, ददर्श saw, ह indeed.

40023130.author: Translation
40023130.content: Having heard Lakshmana's words, King Rama dismissed Kala and quickly came out to see the son of Atri.

40023131.author: पदार्थः
40023131.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, किं what, कार्यम् work, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Rama, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अभाषत spoke.

40023131.author: Translation
40023131.content: Having saluted the great soul who was blazing with splendor, Rama, with folded hands, asked what his purpose was.

40023132.author: पदार्थः
40023132.content: तत् that, वाक्यं word, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, प्रभुम् to the lord, प्रत्याह replied, रामं to Rama, दुर्वासाः Durvasa, श्रूयतां let it be heard, धर्मवत्सल O lover of righteousness.

40023132.author: Translation
40023132.content: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, the best of sages, Durvasa, replied to the lord, saying, "O lover of righteousness, listen."

40023133.author: पदार्थः
40023133.content: अनघ O sinless one, अद्य today, मम my, वर्षसहस्रस्य of a thousand years, तपसः of penance, समाप्तिः is the completion, सः अहम् I therefore, यथासिद्धं whatever is ready, भोजनम् food, इच्छामि desire.

40023133.author: Translation
40023133.content: O sinless one, today marks the completion of my thousand-year penance, and so I desire whatever food is ready to break my fast.

40023134.author: पदार्थः
40023134.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, वचनं word, राजा king, राघवः Rama, प्रीतमानसः with a pleased mind, भोजनं food, मुनिमुख्याय to the chief of sages, यथासिद्धम् as prepared, उपाहरत् offered.

40023134.author: Translation
40023134.content: Having heard that word, King Rama, with a pleased mind, offered food to the chief of sages as it was prepared.

40023135.author: पदार्थः
40023135.content: सः he, तु indeed, भुक्त्वा having eaten, मुनिश्रेष्ठः the best of sages, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, साधु excellent, राम Rama, इति thus, सम्भाष्य having spoken, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् returned.

40023135.author: Translation
40023135.content: Having eaten that nectar-like food, the best of sages praised Rama saying "Excellent, Rama!" and then returned to his own hermitage.

40023136.author: पदार्थः
40023136.content: तस्मिन् when he, गते had gone, मुनिवरे the excellent sage, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः the elder brother of Lakshmana, संस्मृत्य having remembered, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, ततः then, दुःखम् sorrow, उपागमत् felt.

40023136.author: Translation
40023136.content: After that excellent sage had returned to his hermitage, Rama, the elder brother of Lakshmana, remembered the words of Kala and was then overcome with sorrow.

40023137.author: पदार्थः
40023137.content: दुःखेन by sorrow, च and, सुसन्तप्तः greatly afflicted, स्मृत्वा having remembered, तत् that, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, दीनमनाः with a dejected mind, व्याहर्तुं to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.

40023137.author: Translation
40023137.content: Deeply distressed by sorrow and remembering that terrible sight, he became downcast and dejected, unable to utter a word.

40023138.author: पदार्थः
40023138.content: ततः then, बुद्ध्या by intellect, विनिश्चित्य having ascertained, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, राघवः Rama, न not, एतत् this, अस्ति is, इति thus, निश्चित्य having decided, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.

40023138.author: Translation
40023138.content: Then, the greatly renowned Rama, having intellectually ascertained the words of Kala and deciding that "this is not (to be avoided)", remained silent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 105 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
